advanced-filter-description: Mɔɖeɖe ŋgɔyiyi na mɔ be woaŋlɔ fli si me dɔwɔnadzesi siawo le: == != <= >= && || ( ) Wozã teƒe gbɔlo be woama dɔwɔnadzesiwo dome. Àte ŋu amɔ agble tɔxɛwo katã to woƒe ŋkɔwo kple asixɔxɔwo ŋɔŋlɔ dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == Value1. Dzesi: Ne teƒe gbɔlo le agblewo alo asixɔxɔwo me la, ele be nàtsɔ wo ade kaklã ɖeka me. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Be woatsɔ asi adzo le dziɖudzesi ɖeka (' \/) ŋu la, àte ŋu azã \. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: Field1 == I\'m. Àte ŋu atsɔ nɔnɔme geɖewo afli ɖekae hã. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Zi geɖe la, woɖea dɔwɔnadzesiwo katã me tso miame yi nuɖusime. Àte ŋu atrɔ̃ ɖoɖo la to kaklãwo deɖe me dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Àte ŋu adi nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe agblewo hã to regex zazã me: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-deck: Tsɔ NextCloud Deck kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe JSON de afisia (kpekpeɖeŋu si me "stacks" le, stack ɖesiaɖe kɔa eƒe "cards"). Stacks atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye cards atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Tsɔ OpenProject ƒe dɔ-kpekpewo ƒe JSON de afisia (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Nɔnɔmewo atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔ-kpekpewo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-issues: Tsɔ __sourceName__ ƒe kuxiwo ƒe JSON fli de afisia (__endpoint__). Kuxiwo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo si woƒu ƒu ɖe Open / Closed xexlẽdzesiwo me.
import-board-instruction-asana: Tsɔ Asana dɔwo ƒe JSON si wotsɔ ɖe go de afisia ({ "data": [...] } tso Asana ƒe nuɖeɖego alo GET /tasks). Woƒu dɔwo ƒu ɖe akpa me (memberships); dɔ siwo wowu nu la yina Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Tsɔ ZenKit ƒe xexlẽdzesi JSON si wotsɔ ɖe go de afisia ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye items atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Tsɔ markdown dɔwɔwɔ ƒe xexlẽme pepa ɖo (mɔ si markdown-kanban dɔwɔnu siwo abe Obsidian Kanban ene zãna): "## List ƒe ŋkɔ" tanya siwo, kple nu siwo nye "- [ ]"/"- [x]" le woƒe te. Tanya siwo trɔna zua lisiwo eye nu siwo trɔna zua kaatawo; bullet list tsɔtsɔ si mele checkbox aɖeke ŋu o hã ge ɖe eme, abe kaata ʋuʋu ene.
import-board-instruction-leo: Kle Leo ƒe ɖoɖo (faɛl .leo) ɖe afisia. Akpa siwo le ɣome si kɔ wu la zu xexlẽdzesiwo, akpa siwo le wo te tẽ la zu agbalẽviwo, eye akpa la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ zu agbalẽvi la ƒe numeɖeɖe. Akpa siwo le ɣome siwo le eme goglo wu la zu dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesiwo. Wotsɔa akpa siwo wode dzesi la va eme abe nu siwo wu enu ene.
import-board-instruction-opml: Tsɔ OPML ƒe ɖoɖo de eme, abe ale si Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq kple ɖoɖowɔdɔwɔnu bubuwo ɖenɛ ene. Nu siwo le tame zua xexlẽdzesiwo, woƒe viwo zua kaɖiwo kple nuŋlɔɖi abe numeɖeɖe ene, eye nu siwo le te wu zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo. Nu siwo wowu nu la vaa eme abe nu siwo wowu ene.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Tsɔ Org mode faɛl de eme, abe ale si Emacs, Orgzly alo Beorg ŋlɔnɛ ene. Tanya siwo le tame zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye tanya siwo le ɖoƒe evelia zua kaɖiwo. Wodzraa TODO kple DONE, nu vevitɔwo, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE kple CLOSED ɖo, eye dzesideɖefewo kple tanya siwo le te wu zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kle todo.txt ƒe faɛl aɖe ɖe afi sia: dɔ ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe me, abe ale si todo.txt dɔwɔnu kple dɔwɔnu siwo sɔ kplii ŋlɔe ene. Dɔ siwo wu enu ("x") yina Dɔwuɖeɖi me, +project kple @context trɔna zu dzesiwo, (A) trɔna zu nukpɔsusu gbãtɔ ƒe dzesi, eye due: kple t: trɔna zu nuwuwu ŋkeke kple gɔmedzedze ŋkeke.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Te task export ƒe emetsonu ɖe afisia: JSON xexlẽdzesi, alo dɔ ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe dzi. Dɔ siwo wowu nu le yina ɖe Done me, project kple priority trɔna dzua dzesiwo, annotations trɔna dzua nuŋɔŋlɔwo, eye depends trɔna dzua kadodowo kple dɔ siwo le mɔ xɛm na dɔa.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ʋu .boardarchive ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe eye nàte kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe board.jsonl ɖe afisia, kple eƒe tɔtrɔ ƒe fli alo emanɔmee. Nɔnɔme si ƒoa nuwo nu ƒu ɖe ƒuƒoƒowo me le kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me trɔna dzua xexlẽdzesiwo, tiatia ƒe nɔnɔme bubuwo trɔna dzua dzesiwo, nuŋɔŋlɔ kple dzesidede ƒe aɖaka ƒe akpa siwo le eme trɔna dzua numeɖeɖe kple dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi, eye woléa nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖe asi. Wometsɔa nɔnɔmetatawo kple kpeɖeŋu-agbalẽwo va eme o.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Le Azure DevOps me, ʋu Boards, emegbe Queries, wɔ biabia aɖe si ɖea fli siwo nèdi la fiana, eye nàtia Export to CSV; tia .csv faɛl ma. Board Column (alo State) zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye Board Lane zua mɔwo; dɔwɔnuwo zua agbalẽviwo kple woƒe ƒomevi kple tags abe dzesiwo ene, Assigned To, ŋkekewo, ɖeɖefia kple dzila, eye fli bubuawo zua wò ŋutɔ wò teƒewo.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Le Microsoft Lists me, ʋu xexlẽdzesi la, tia Export, emegbe Export to CSV, eye nàtia .csv faɛl ma. Status fli (alo Progress) zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye nu ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi, kple eƒe tanya, ɖeɖefia, amewo, ŋkekewo kple tags; fli bubuawo zua wò ŋutɔ wò teƒewo.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Le Microsoft Project me, tia File, emegbe Save As, kple ƒomevi XML Format (*.xml), eye nàtia faɛl ma. Dɔ kpuiwo zua mɔwo eye dɔwo zua agbalẽviwo le Womedze egɔme o, Ele edzi yim alo Wowu enu me, kple woƒe ŋkekewo, nuŋɔŋlɔwo, nunɔamesiwo, dɔ suewo kple esiwo do ŋgɔ.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Le Outlook me, he gbedeasiwo yi agbalẽdzraɖoƒe aɖe me le wò kɔmpiuta dzi, alo dzra wo ɖo kple File, emegbe Save As, abe Outlook Message Format (*.msg) ene. Tia .msg faɛl ɖeka, alo .zip si me .msg kple .eml faɛlwo le. Dzeɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi le Board View / Email me, kple eƒe ŋuɖoɖowo abe nuŋɔŋlɔwo ene kple eƒe nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu abe faɛlwo ene.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Le MeisterTask me la, zi dɔ la ƒe ŋkɔ dzi, tia Export project eye nàɖe CSV la, emegbe tsɔe de eme. Akpawo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, ŋkeke mamlɛ, dɔwɔla kple tags; dɔ siwo wowu nu la léa woƒe nuwuwuŋkeke ɖe asi. CSV si woŋlɔ na MeisterTask ŋutɔ ƒe nuxɔxɔ hã wɔa dɔ.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Le Obsidian me la, ʋu Kanban kpekpeɖeŋu la ƒe faɛl abe Markdown ene (alo ʋu .md faɛl la le nuŋlɔdɔwɔnu me), emegbe tsɔ ewo katã de eme. Mɔwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo kple woƒe kaɖiwo ƒe seɖoƒe, kaɖiwo léa woƒe tags, ŋkekewo, nu vevitɔ, agblewo kple ŋkuɖodzinudzesi ɖe asi, eye Archive zua kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-linear: Le Linear me la, ɖe nyawo abe CSV ene (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, alo nukpɔkpɔ aɖe ƒe ɖeɖe), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, ƒuƒoƒowo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye nyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔwɔla, dzesiwo, ŋkekewo, nya dzitsotso, nu vevitɔ, akɔntabubu, dɔ kple ɣeyiɣi ƒe trɔtrɔ.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Le TickTick me la, ʋu Settings, Account, Backup & Import eye nàwɔ nudzraɖoɖo, emegbe tsɔ CSV faɛl la de eme. TickTick xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe zua tsiƒuƒu eye eƒe ƒlowo zua xexlẽdzesiwo; dɔwo léa woƒe tags, ŋkekewo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesi, nu vevitɔ kple dɔviwo ɖe asi.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Le ClickUp me la, ɖe dɔwo abe CSV ene (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, alo List alo Table nukpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖeɖe kple ƒlowo katã), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, ClickUp xexlẽdzesiwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔviwo, dɔwɔlawo, tags, ŋkekewo, nu vevitɔ kple ɣeyiɣi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Le Nullboard me la, ʋu kpekpeɖeŋu la, tia Export this board... le nuɖoɖowo me, ʋu .nbx faɛl la le nuŋlɔdɔwɔnu me eye nàtsɔ eme nuwo de eme. Xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye nuŋlɔɖiwo zua kaɖiwo: nuŋlɔɖi ƒe fli gbãtɔ nye kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔ eye esusɔea nye eƒe numeɖeɖe. Nuŋlɔɖi si womeɖo ɖoɖo na o la xɔa dzesi raw. Faɛl si me kpekpeɖeŋu geɖe le la tsɔa eƒe kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vaa eme.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Le Kanri me la, ʋu Import & Export eye nàtia Export individual board (alo Export all data), emegbe tsɔ .json faɛl la de eme. Ƒlowo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye kaɖiwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe numeɖeɖe, ŋkeke mamlɛ, tags kple amawo; kaɖi ƒe dɔwo zua ŋkuɖodzinudzesi. Le nyatakakawo katã ƒe ɖeɖe me la, wotsɔa kpekpeɖeŋu gbãtɔ vaa eme.
import-board-instruction-planka: Ŋlɔ wò Planka ƒe adrɛs (le kpɔɖeŋu me https://planka.example.com), wò Planka zãla ŋkɔ kple ɣaɣlanya, eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi. Wozãa wo hena ŋɔŋlɔkpe la xɔxɔ ko eye womedzraa wo ɖo o. Tia ŋɔŋlɔkpe aɖe eye nàzi Xɔe dzi: WeKan xlẽnɛ tso Planka ƒe API me, kple eƒe xexlẽdzesiwo, agbalẽviwo, numeɖeɖewo, ŋkeke mamlɛtɔwo, dzesiwo, hametɔwo, dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo, eye nàyi tsɔ va eme dzi abe ale si wòle ɖaa ene. Agbalẽvi siwo le Planka ƒe dzraɖoƒe la vaa eme abe esiwo wodzra ɖo ene; nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu kple agbalẽvi siwo le gbeƒeƒeƒe mevaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Le Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) me, ge ɖe eme, lɔ̃ ɖe Tasks.Read ƒe mɔɖeɖe dzi eye nàkɔpi token la tso Access token tab la dzi. Tsɔe da ɖe afii eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi; wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Tia xexlẽdzesiwo katã alo ɖeka eye nàzi Xɔe dzi. To Do xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe zua xexlẽdzesi eye dɔ ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi, kple eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ kple gɔmedzeŋkeke, afɔɖeɖewo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene, ƒomeawo abe dzesiwo ene, eye vevienyenye gã kple nɔnɔme abe dzesiwo ene; dɔ siwo wu enu yia dzraɖoƒe. Ŋkuɖodzinuwo kple gbugbɔgawɔwo mevaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Le Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) me, ge ɖe eme, lɔ̃ ɖe Notes.Read ƒe mɔɖeɖe dzi eye nàkɔpi token la tso Access token tab la dzi. Tsɔe da ɖe afii eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi; wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Tia nuŋlɔgbalẽ aɖe eye nàzi Xɔe dzi. Akpawo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye axawo zua agbalẽviwo, kple woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ, dɔ siwo woawɔ ƒe gbɔgbɔwo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene kple axa suewo abe dɔ suewo ene.
import-board-instruction-teams: Tsɔ Microsoft Graph ƒe token si me Chat.Read le (tso Graph Explorer, dɔwɔƒe alo suku ƒe akɔnta) da ɖe afii eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, emegbe tia dzeɖoɖo alo kanal aɖe eye nàzi Xɔe dzi; womedzraa token la ɖo o. Alo tia faɛl aɖe: wò ŋutɔ wò export ƒe .tar tso teams.live.com/dataexport, alo dzeɖoɖo gbedeasiwo ƒe .json. Dzeɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi le Board View / Chat me, eƒe gbedeasiwo zua nuŋɔŋlɔwo.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Le Sandstorm me la, ʋu __app__ ƒe grain, tia Download backup le grain la ƒe dzigbe bar dzi, eye nàtia .zip faɛl ma. Grain la me nuwo zua ŋɔŋlɔkpe, eye eƒe nuwo zua agbalẽviwo kple nu siwo app la dzra ɖo tso wo ŋu. Tia app si tɔ grain la nye: wogbe app bubu ƒe grain, eye wògblɔa app si wònye.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Le KanbanFlow me, ʋu ŋɔŋlɔkpe la ƒe menu, tia Settings → API & Webhooks eye nàkɔpi ŋɔŋlɔkpe la ƒe API token. Tsɔ token la da ɖe afii, zi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, tia ŋɔŋlɔkpe la eye nàzi Xɔe dzi; wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ ma ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Ʋɔtruwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye mɔwo nɔa mɔwo; dɔwo léa woƒe numeɖeɖe, amadede, dzesiwo, ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ, dɔ suewo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene, ɣeyiɣi si wozã, ɖoɖo, amewo kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo me ɖe asi.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Ŋlɔ wò Basecamp akɔnta ƒe ID (xexlẽdzesi si le basecamp.com/ megbe le adrɛs la me) kple mɔnukpɔkpɔ token (tso OAuth 2 app aɖe si woŋlɔ ŋkɔ le launchpad.37signals.com dzi me, alo esi integration aɖe si li xoxo la tsɔ ɖi), zi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, tia dɔwɔwɔ aɖe eye nàzi Xɔe dzi. Wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ ma ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Agbalẽvi kplɔ̃ ɖesiaɖe zua mɔ si ƒe ʋɔtruwo nye xexlẽdzesiwo, eye nusiwo woawɔ ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo zua To-dos mɔ; agbalẽviwo kple nusiwo woawɔ léa woƒe nuŋlɔɖi, ŋkekewo, ame siwo wode asi na kple nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖe asi, agbalẽvi ƒe afɔɖeɖewo zua dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi, eye esiwo wu enu yia dzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Xɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ token tso OAuth 2.0 Playground: le Tasks API v1 te tia tasks.readonly, zi Authorize APIs dzi, emegbe Exchange authorization code for tokens, eye nàkɔpi mɔnukpɔkpɔ token la. Tsɔe da ɖe afii eye nàzi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi, tia dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo katã alo ɖeka, emegbe Xɔe. Wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua agbalẽviwo, kple woƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, kadodowo kple ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ; dɔ suewo zua dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi eye dɔ siwo wu enu vaa eme abe esiwo wodzra ɖo ene.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep ƒe API la nye Google Workspace akɔntawo ɖeɖeko tɔ. Xɔ OAuth 2.0 mɔnukpɔkpɔ token kple scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (le OAuth 2.0 Playground me ne wò Workspace dzikpɔla ɖe mɔ, alo tso dɔwɔƒe akɔnta aɖe si si ŋusẽ le le domain bliboa dzi), tsɔe da eme, zi Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi dzi eye emegbe Xɔe. Wozãa token la hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o. Nuŋlɔɖi ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo zua agbalẽviwo le xexlẽdzesi Nuŋɔŋlɔwo me, eye dodokpɔ nuŋɔŋlɔwo zua agbalẽviwo le xexlẽdzesi Xexlẽdzesiwo me kple woƒe nuwo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene. Nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo le gbeƒeƒeƒe, nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu kple mama mevaa eme o.
api-import-desc: Xɔe tso dɔwɔƒe la kple wò ŋutɔ wò akɔnta. Nu si nàŋlɔ ɖe afii la, wozãnɛ hena xɔxɔ sia ko eye womedzraa eɖo o.
api-import-list: Ŋlɔ Xexlẽdzesi na nu siwo ate ŋu ava eme
api-import-fetched: Wòxɔe. Kpɔ hametɔ siwo le ete eye nàtsɔ va eme.
api-import-nothing: Naneke meli be woatsɔ va eme kple akɔnta sia o.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Le Pivotal Tracker me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe MORE axa eye nàtia Export CSV (alo tia ŋutinyawo eye nàtia Bulk Actions, CSV), emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Ŋutinya ƒe nɔnɔme ɖesiaɖe zua xexlẽdzesi eye ŋutinyawo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe ƒomevi kple dzesiwo, tɔwo, biala, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, dɔwo kple mɔxenuwo; Estimate zua Story points eye trɔtrɔwo zua sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Le Tasks.org me la, ʋu Settings, Backups eye nàtia Export tasks, emegbe tsɔ .json faɛl ma me nuwo de eme. Xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, tags, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple dɔviwo; dɔ siwo wowu nu la léa woƒe nuwuwuŋkeke ɖe asi, eye nu vevitɔ zua agble tɔxɛ.
import-board-instruction-monday: Le monday.com me la, ʋu kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nuɖoɖowo, tia More actions kple Export board to Excel (kple updates kple subitems ne èdi), emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Status ƒlo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye ƒuƒoƒowo zua tsiƒuƒuwo; amewo, ŋkekewo, ɣeyiɣi ƒe mɔ kple tags léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi, ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo eye updates zua nyaŋuɖoɖowo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Le Super Productivity me la, ʋu Settings, emegbe Sync & Backup, tia Export Data eye nàtsɔ sp-backup .json faɛl la me nuwo de eme. Dɔ ɖesiaɖe zua tsiƒuƒu eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo le To Do, In Progress, Backlog alo Done me, kple woƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo, tags, ŋkeke mamlɛ, ɣeyiɣi si wozã kple dɔviwo; dɔ siwo le nudzraɖoƒe zua kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Le Taiga me la, ʋu Admin > Project > Export eye nàxɔ dɔ la ƒe nudzraɖoɖo (ʋu .json.gz faɛl gbã), emegbe tsɔ eƒe JSON de eme. Zazãla ƒe ŋutinya ƒe nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, zazãla ƒe ŋutinyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dɔwo abe dɔviwo ene, epics kple nyawo xɔa woawo ŋutɔ ƒe tsiƒuƒuwo, eye sprints, tags, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple nɔnɔme tɔxɛwo hã vaa eme. Wometsɔa nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Le Vikunja me la, ʋu Settings, tia Data Export eye nàxɔ .zip faɛl si wòɖona na wò, emegbe tia faɛl ma, alo tsɔ data.json si le eme de eme. Kanban gazewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe dzesiwo, dɔwɔlawo, ŋkekewo, numeɖeɖe, dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo abe ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo ene kple nyaŋuɖoɖowo; nu vevitɔ, akpa si wowu kple wowu nu zua agble tɔxɛwo. Wometsɔa nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-quire: Le Quire me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe nuɖoɖowo eye nàtia Export CSV, emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe dɔviwo abe kaɖiviwo ene, dɔwɔlawo, tags abe dzesiwo ene, gɔmedzedze, mamlɛ kple nuwuwu ŋkekewo, numeɖeɖe kple nu vevitɔ abe agble tɔxɛ ene. Nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu mele Quire ƒe CSV me o.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Le Wrike me la, ɖe dɔ alo faɛlgba aɖe ɖo Excel me, alo yɔ Wrike ƒe Excel nuxɔxɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu me, emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Faɛlgba kple dɔ ƒe fliwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, Status zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo, kple woƒe Key, dɔ dzitsotso, dɔwɔlawo, gɔmedzedze kple nuwuwu ŋkekewo, nudzidzedzewo kple numeɖeɖe; Priority, Duration kple ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Le Teamwork.com me la, yɔ Excel dɔ nuxɔxɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu la me (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) eye nàdzrae ɖo abe .xlsx ene, emegbe tia faɛl ma. Dɔ xexlẽdzesiwo zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye dɔwo zua kaɖiwo; dɔ si dze egɔme kple -, # alo > la zua dɔvi na dɔ si le edzi (--, ## alo >> ɖoƒe ɖeka le te wu). Dɔwɔlawo, ŋkekewo kple tags léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi; Priority, Estimated time kple Complete zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Le Businessmap (si wona ŋkɔ Kanbanize tsã) me la, ʋu Advanced Search, tia Configure results be nàtia ƒlowo, xɔ Excel faɛl la, emegbe tia .xlsx faɛl ma. Woxlẽa ƒlowo le woƒe Eŋlisigbe ŋkɔwo nu (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ne wò akɔnta zãa gbe bubu la, trɔ tanya ƒe fli la ƒe ŋkɔwo wòazu Eŋlisigbe gbã. Column zua xexlẽdzesiwo eye Lane zua tsiƒuƒuwo; tɔwo, tags, ama, ŋkekewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo kple dzitsotso ƒe kadodowo léa woƒe teƒewo ɖe asi, eye Priority, Size, Type kple ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Le Redmine me la, ʋu dɔ la ƒe Issues, tia Also available in: CSV le xexlẽdzesi la ƒe te, tia ƒlowo (All columns, kple Description) eye nàɖee, emegbe tsɔ CSV la de eme. Redmine naa ŋkɔ ƒlowo le wò gbe me, eyata ɖo wò gbe be wòanye Eŋlisigbe le My account me hafi nàɖee. Nɔnɔme ɖesiaɖe zua xexlẽdzesi eye nyawo zua kaɖiwo, kple tracker abe dzesi ene, dɔwɔla, ŋlɔla, ŋkekewo, dɔ dzitsotso kple nya siwo do ka; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done kple agble tɔxɛwo zua agble tɔxɛwo.
import-board-instruction-notion: Le Notion me la, ʋu nyatakakadzraɖoƒe la abe axa blibo ene, tia ••• kple Export, tia Markdown & CSV, eye nàtia .zip faɛl si wòxɔ, alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒe CSV ɖeka tso eme, alo tsɔ CSV ma de eme. Ƒlo si ŋkɔ nye Status la zua xexlẽdzesiwo (ne eya meli o la, ƒlo gbãtɔ si dze abe tiatia ene la zuna, eye nuxɔxɔ ƒe nyatakaka gblɔa esi wònye); fliwo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe ŋkɔ, tags abe dzesiwo ene, amewo abe dzolawo ene, ŋkekewo, kple axa ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ abe numeɖeɖe ene; ƒlo bubuwo zua agble tɔxɛwo. Wometsɔa kadodowo, nɔnɔmetatawo kple nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-plane: Le Plane me la, ʋu Workspace Settings, tia Exports, ɖe dɔwo abe JSON, CSV alo Excel ene eye nàxɔ .zip faɛl la, emegbe tia faɛl ma, alo faɛl ɖeka si le eme, alo tsɔ JSON alo CSV la de eme. Nɔnɔmewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, dɔwo zua tsiƒuƒuwo, eye nyawo zua kaɖiwo kple woƒe dzesidenu, dzitsotso, dɔwɔlawo, dzesiwo, ŋkekewo, kadodowo kple nyaŋuɖoɖowo; priority, estimate, cycle kple module zua agble tɔxɛwo. Numeɖeɖe alo nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu aɖeke mele Plane ƒe ɖeɖe me o, eyata wometsɔa wo vaa eme o.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Le Fizzy me la, ɖe akɔnta la le "Account settings" me, alo wò ŋutɔ wò agbalẽviwo kple "Download my data", eye nàtia .zip faɛl si Fizzy aɖo ɖe wò, alo agbalẽvi ɖeka ƒe .json faɛl. Ŋɔŋlɔkpewo zua mɔwo, eye tsitreƒewo zua xexlẽdzesiwo, kple "Maybe?", "Not now" kple "Done" abe le Fizzy me ene; agbalẽviwo léa woƒe numeɖeɖe, dzesiwo, dɔwɔlawo, afɔɖeɖewo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene, nuŋɔŋlɔwo kple faɛlwo ɖe asi.
import-board-instruction-mail: Tia .mbox agbalẽ, abe ale si Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt alo Gmail to Google Takeout dzi dzraa wo ɖo ene, alo .eml gbedasi ɖeka, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Dzeɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi ɖeka le xexlẽdzesi Inbox me, kple amesi ɖoe, amesiwo wòɖo na kple eƒe tanya, ale be wòadze le Email kpɔkpɔ me; ŋuɖoɖowo zua eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo. Gmail ƒe dzesiwo zua dzesiwo. Nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-ical: Tia .ics kalenda agbalẽ, abe ale si Google Calendar, Apple Calendar alo Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud alo Outlook doa goe ene, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Dɔwo yia To Do, In Progress, Done alo Cancelled me le woƒe nɔnɔme nu, eye nudzɔdzɔwo yia Events me, kple woƒe gɔmedzeŋkeke kple ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ, ale be woadze le Calendar kple Gantt kpɔkpɔwo me. Hatsotsowo kple vevienyenye zua dzesiwo. Nu siwo gbugbɔna va la, wotsɔa wo vaa eme zi ɖeka.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Le takeout.google.com dzi la, tia Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar kple Google Chat, wɔ dodo la eye nàtsɔ .zip agbalẽ la ɖe anyi, emegbe tiae le afisia. Nudzɔdzɔ ɖesiaɖe zua mɔ: lɛta na Email kpɔkpɔ, dɔ ƒe xexlẽdzesiwo kple nuŋlɔɖiwo kple woƒe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesiwo, kalenda ƒe nudzɔdzɔwo kple dɔwo kple ŋkekewo, kple dzeɖoɖo teƒe siwo ƒe gbedasiwo nye nuŋɔŋlɔwo na Chat kpɔkpɔ. Nudzɔdzɔ bubuwo kple nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-slack: Le Slack me la, ʋu dɔwɔƒe ƒe ɖoɖowo, tia Import/Export Data, do dɔwɔƒe la goe eye nàtsɔ .zip agbalẽ la ɖe anyi, emegbe tiae le afisia. Mɔ ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi le Channels, Groups alo Direct messages me, eye eƒe gbedasiwo kple ŋuɖoɖowo zua agbalẽvi la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, le amesi ŋlɔ wo nu, ale be Chat kpɔkpɔ naɖe mɔ la afia. Agbalẽwo, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Do goe kple mmctl export create, tsɔ dodo la ɖe anyi eye nàtia eƒe .jsonl agbalẽ, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Mɔ ɖesiaɖe kple gbedasi tẽ ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi, eye eƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo kple ŋuɖoɖowo zua agbalẽvi la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, ale be Chat kpɔkpɔ naɖe mɔ la afia. Ƒuƒoƒowo zua mɔwo. Agbalẽwo, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Le Telegram Desktop me la, ʋu Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, tia JSON ɖoɖo eye nàdoe goe, emegbe tia result.json agbalẽ la, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Dzeɖoɖo ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi le Direct messages, Groups alo Channels me, eye eƒe gbedasiwo zua agbalẽvi la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, ale be Chat kpɔkpɔ naɖe dzeɖoɖo la afia. Foto kple agbalẽwo, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Le WhatsApp me la, ʋu dzeɖoɖo la, tia Export chat si me foto kple video mele o, eye nàtia .txt agbalẽ la le afisia, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Dzeɖoɖo la zua agbalẽvi si ƒe gbedasiwo nye eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, le amesi ɖoe kple ɣeyiɣi nu, ale be Chat kpɔkpɔ naɖee afia. Foto kple video kple ɖoɖo ƒe gbedasiwo, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-discord: Do Discord mɔ goe kple DiscordChatExporter le JSON ɖoɖo me eye nàtia .json agbalẽ la, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Mɔ la zua agbalẽvi le eƒe hatsotso me, eye eƒe gbedasiwo zua agbalẽvi la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, ale be Chat kpɔkpɔ naɖe mɔ la afia. Dɔdzikpɔla la zua mɔ la. Nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Le Rocket.Chat me la, ɖe wò nyatakakawo abe JSON ene le "My Data" me eye nàtia .zip faɛl si woaɖo ɖe wò, alo xɔ ɖeka ƒe .json faɛl si woɖe. Xɔ ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi, eye eƒe gbedasiwo zua agbalẽvi la ƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo, ale be Chat kpɔkpɔ naɖe xɔ la afia. Woxlẽa .zip si WeKan ɖena na Rocket.Chat ƒe CSV xɔla hã.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Le Evernote me la, do nuŋlɔɖiwo alo nuŋlɔɖigbalẽ goe abe .enex agbalẽ ene eye nàtiae le afisia, alo tsɔ eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ de afisia. Nuŋlɔɖi ɖesiaɖe zua agbalẽvi kple eƒe nuŋɔŋlɔ, eƒe dɔ ƒe dzesigoewo abe dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesi ene, eƒe tagwo abe dzesiwo ene kple eƒe ŋkuɖodzinya abe ŋkeke mamlɛtɔ ene; nuŋlɔɖi siwo ƒe ŋkuɖodzinya wu enu la yia Done me. Nɔnɔmetatawo kple agbalẽ siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu la, womatsɔ wo ava eme o.
tool-group-issues: Kuxiwo ŋuti dzikpɔlawo kple tɔtrɔ ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ
tool-group-tasks: Dɔwo kple nusiwo woawɔ ƒe apps
menu-group-export: Do goe kple tsɔ va eme
report-average-days-late: Ŋkeke siwo wotsi megbe le titina
report-projected-finish: Nuwuwu si wole mɔ kpɔm na
import-board-instruction-trello: Le wò Trello kpekpeɖeŋu me la, yi 'Menu', emegbe 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', eye nàkɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ si va la.
import-board-instruction-csv: Tsɔ nusiwo woma kple koma (CSV)/ nusiwo woma kple tab (TSV) de afisia.
import-board-instruction-jira: Tsɔ JSON tso Jira Cloud REST API kuxi didi me de afisia (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), alo nu si sɔ kple { "issues": [...] }. Jira ƒe nɔnɔmewo atrɔ̃ azu xexlẽdzesiwo eye kuxiwo atrɔ̃ azu kaɖiwo. Àte ŋu atsɔ "automationRules" ƒe fli akpe ɖe eŋu be nàtsɔ sewo ava eme.
import-board-instruction-excel: Tia WeKan-nɔnɔme ƒe .xlsx kplɔ̃gbalẽ (agble ɖeka siwo le Excel ƒe nuɖeɖego me: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Fli gbãtɔ nye tameŋɔŋlɔ.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Le wò kpekpeɖeŋu me la, yi 'Menu', emegbe 'Export board', eye nàkɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ si le agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe anyi me.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Ne vodadawo va le kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã me la, zi aɖewo dzi nu tsɔtsɔ vavã megbe dze edzi, eye kpekpeɖeŋu la le Kpekpeɖeŋuwo katã ƒe axa dzi.
import-without-mapping-members: Tsɔ va eme medodo dzolawo go o (do wo go emegbe)
import-members-mode-map: Tia zazãla si li xoxo na wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe
import-members-mode-placeholder: Na woanɔ anyi abe teƒeɖoɖo zazãlawo ene kple woawo ŋutɔ ƒe ŋkɔwo, be nàtsɔ wo asɔ kple zazãla vavãwo emegbe
csv-mapping-description: Tia faɛl la ƒe ƒlo si me kaɖi ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe le. Wotia nuwo tso ƒlowo ƒe ŋkɔwo me; trɔ esiwo menyo o, eye nàtia (mele faɛl la me o) na agble si mele faɛl la me o.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Ƒlo aɖeke mele faɛl la me na xexlẽdzesi la o. Tia ɖeka le etame, alo ŋlɔ xexlẽdzesi ɖeka si me kaɖiwo katã ayi la ƒe ŋkɔ.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Ƒlo bubu siwo woatsɔ va eme abe nuŋɔŋlɔ agble tɔxɛwo ene:
csv-mapping-boards: Axa ɖesiaɖe zua eya ŋutɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu:
csv-mapping-skipped-sheets: Axa siwo wometsɔ va eme o:
csv-mapping-title-required: Tia ƒlo si me kaɖiwo ƒe ŋkɔwo le.
csv-mapping-list-required: Ŋlɔ xexlẽdzesi si me kaɖiwo katã ayi la ƒe ŋkɔ, alo tia ƒlo si me xexlẽdzesi la le.
invalid-import-mapping: Ƒlowo ƒe ɖoɖo la mesɔ kple faɛl la o.
import-many-boards-hint: Tia dɔwɔnu sia ƒe ɖeɖe faɛl geɖewo, alo .zip ɖeka si me wole: faɛl ɖesiaɖe zua eya ŋutɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu, si wotsɔ va eme dzolawo ƒe sɔsɔ manɔmee. .zip si ŋutɔ nye ɖeɖe ɖeka (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, alo WeKan kple nu siwo wokpe ɖe eŋu) nye kpekpeɖeŋu ɖeka. Ne wotia faɛlwo le afisia la, Import tsɔa wo vaa eme le agble si le etame teƒe.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Tsiƒuƒu ɖesiaɖe si nuxɔxɔ la awɔ (dɔwɔnu la ƒe dɔ, faɛlgba alo xexlẽdzesi) zua eya ŋutɔ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Wolɔ̃a kaɖi dzitsotsowo kple nudzidzedze siwo le kpekpeɖeŋu mawo dome ɖe nuxɔxɔ ƒe nyatakaka me.
import-many-progress: Ele __done__ le __total__ me tsɔm va eme: __name__
export-all-boards-hint: Kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe si nàte ŋu aɖe, le xɔxɔ ɖeka me: Excel abe dɔwɔgbalẽ ɖeka ene kple axa ɖeka na kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe si woyɔ ɖe eŋkɔ, eye ɖoɖo bubu ɖesiaɖe abe .zip ene kple faɛl ɖeka na kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe.
import-json-placeholder: Tsɔ wò JSON nyatakaka si sɔ la de afisia
import-csv-placeholder: Tsɔ wò CSV/TSV nyatakaka si sɔ la de afisia
import-attachments-zip: Trello ƒe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu ZIP (menye se o, tso Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Trello kpekpeɖeŋu ɖeka si wotsɔ ɖe go abe .json ene. Ne èdzra Trello API key kple token ɖo la, woatsɔ eƒe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu, kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe megbe kple dzolawo ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo ɖe anyi hã.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: .zip si me kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe .json agbalẽ ɖeka alo geɖe kple woƒe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu le kpekpeɖeŋu-ŋkɔ ƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒeviwo me (tso Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Woatsɔ kpekpeɖeŋuwo katã ava eme.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Womekpɔ Trello kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe .json agbalẽ aɖeke le .zip la me o.
import-trello-zip-progress: Wole kpekpeɖeŋuwo tsɔm vavã tso .zip, taflatse lala…
import-trello-failed: Nu tsɔtsɔ vavã tso Trello medze edzi o.
import-timeout: Nu tsɔtsɔ vavã xɔ ɣeyiɣi didi akpa ale wotu. Taflatse gbugbɔ kpɔ; ne egale edziedzi la, ɖewohĩ kpekpeɖeŋu la lolo akpa alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒe la le dɔ geɖe wɔm.
import-too-large: Faɛl la lolo akpa be woatsɔe ade eme zi ɖeka. Mã eme wòanye faɛl suesuewo, abe dɔwɔwɔ alo ŋkeke nu ene, eye nàtsɔ wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe ade eme.
import-trello-zip-read-failed: Mate ŋu axlẽ .zip si wotsɔ ɖe dzi la o.
import-trello-zip-too-large: .zip la lolo akpa be woatsɔe ava eme.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: Agbalẽwo sɔ gbɔ le .zip la me be woatsɔ wo ava eme.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Agbalẽ aɖe le .zip la me lolo akpa be woatsɔe ava eme.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: Agbalẽ ƒe mɔ siwo mele dedie o le .zip la me, eya ta wogbee.
import-trello-workspace: Ŋutɔ ƒe dɔwɔƒe ƒe ŋkɔ (menye se o)
import-attachment-auth: Nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu ƒe faɛlwo
import-attachment-auth-hint: Nusi wodɔ ɖa la yɔ nu siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu ƒe ŋkɔwo, gake metsɔ faɛlwo ŋutɔ o. Be nàtsɔ wo vɛ la, na dɔwɔƒe la ƒe adrɛs kple gegeɖeme nyatakakawo: wozãa wo na nutsɔvaeme sia ɖeɖe ko, woɖoa wo ɖe adrɛs ma ɖeɖe ko, eye womedzraa wo ɖo gbeɖe o. globalSearch-instructions-description: Didiwo ate ŋu akpɔ dɔwɔnadzesiwo be woana didi la nu naɖi. Woɖea dɔwɔnadzesi fia to dɔwɔnadzesi ƒe ŋkɔ kple asixɔxɔ ŋɔŋlɔ si woma kple dzesi eve dzi. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, dɔwɔnadzesi `list:Blocked` aɖo didi la ƒe seƒoƒo ɖe kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi si ƒe ŋkɔ nye *Blocked* me. Ne teƒe gbɔlo alo dzesi tɔxɛwo le asixɔxɔ la me la, ele be woatsɔe ade nyaŋɔŋlɔ ƒe dzesiwo me (kpɔɖeŋu `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kaɖi siwo le kpekpeɖeŋu siwo sɔ kple *<title>* si woɖe fia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi siwo sɔ kple *<title>* si woɖe fia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - kaɖi siwo le tsiƒuƒu siwo sɔ kple *<title>* si woɖe fia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - kaɖi siwo si nyaŋuɖoɖo si kɔ *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaɖi siwo si dzesi si sɔ kple *<color>* alo *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - kaɖi siwo me *<username>* nye kaɖi ƒe ewɔla
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaɖi siwo nye kpekpeɖeŋu si wode na habɔbɔ *<name>* tɔ
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaɖi siwo nye kpekpeɖeŋu si wode na ƒuƒoƒo *<name>* tɔ
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaɖi siwo ƒe ŋkeke mamlɛ le *<n>* ŋkeke me tso fifia. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ ŋlɔa kaɖi siwo katã ƒe ŋkeke mamlɛ va yi.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaɖi siwo wowɔ *<n>* ŋkeke va yi alo didi wu o
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaɖi siwo wotrɔ̃ *<n>* ŋkeke va yi alo didi wu o
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - teƒe si *<status>* nye nusiwo gbɔna dometɔ ɖeka:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - kaɖi siwo katã le nudzraɖoƒe kple nusiwo mele eme o
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - kaɖi siwo le dutoƒo ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo dzi ko
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - kaɖi siwo le ame tɔxɛ ƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo dzi ko
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - teƒe si *<field>* nye `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` alo `__predicate_member__` dometɔ ɖeka. `-` deɖe *<field>* ŋgɔ dia teƒe si asixɔxɔ aɖeke mele agble ma me o (kpɔɖeŋu `has:-due` dia kaɖi siwo si ŋkeke mamlɛ aɖeke meli o).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - teƒe si *<sort-name>* nye `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` alo `__predicate_modified__` dometɔ ɖeka. Na ɖoɖo si dzea anyi la, tsɔ `-` de ɖoɖo ƒe ŋkɔ ŋgɔ.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - teƒe si *<n>* nye blibo si le 0 dzi, si fia kaɖiwo ƒe xexlẽme si woafia le axa ɖesiaɖe dzi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Woate ŋu aɖe dɔwɔnadzesi geɖewo afia.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Woƒoa dɔwɔnadzesi siwo sɔ ƒu kple *OR*. Woagbugbɔ kaɖi siwo sɔ kple nɔnɔmeawo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` agbugbɔ kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi ɖesiaɖe si ƒe ŋkɔ nye *Blocked* alo *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Wokɔa dɔwɔnadzesi siwo me ɖe vovo kple *AND*. Kaɖi siwo sɔ kple dɔwɔnadzesi vovovoawo katã ko woagbugbɔ. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` gbugbɔa kaɖi siwo le xexlẽdzesi *Available* me kple dzesi *red* ko.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Woate ŋu aɖe ŋkeke afia abe blibo si le 0 dzi alo le 0 te, alo woazã `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` alo `__predicate_year__` na ɣeyiɣi si li fifia.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Nuŋɔŋlɔ didi mekpɔ ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gã alo sue gbɔ o.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Le gɔmedzedze me womedi kaɖi siwo le nudzraɖoƒe o.

cron-job-pause-failed: Dɔ si woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi ƒe tete vie medze edzi o
cron-job-paused: Wote dɔ si woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi vie dzidzedzetɔe
cron-job-resume-failed: Dɔ si woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi ƒe gbugbɔgɔmedzedze medze edzi o
cron-job-resumed: Wogbugbɔ dze dɔ si woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi gɔme dzidzedzetɔe
cron-job-start-failed: Dɔ si woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi ƒe gɔmedzedze medze edzi o
cron-job-started: Wodze dɔ si woɖo le ɣeyiɣi dzi gɔme dzidzedzetɔe
cron-no-errors: Vodada aɖeke meli be woafia o
cron-retry-failed: Gbugbɔ kpɔ nusɔsɔ siwo medze edzi o
cron-resume-paused: Gbugbɔ dze nusɔsɔ siwo wote vie gɔme
cron-no-failed-migrations: Nusɔsɔ si medze edzi o aɖeke meli be woagbugbɔ akpɔ o
cron-no-paused-migrations: Nusɔsɔ si wote vie aɖeke meli be woagbugbɔ adze gɔme o
cron-migrations-retried: Wogbugbɔ kpɔ nusɔsɔ siwo medze edzi o dzidzedzetɔe
filesystem-path-description: Gɔmedzedze ƒe mɔ na agbalẽ nudzraɖoɖo
filesystem-disabled: Woxe mɔ na agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ nudzraɖoƒe
filesystem-enabled-description: Zã teƒe sia ƒe agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ na agbalẽ nudzraɖoɖo
s3-minio-storage-description: Nudzraɖoƒe si sɔ kple S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces kple bubuwo.
s3-force-path-style-description: MinIO kple dɔdzikpɔla geɖe siwo menye AWS o gake sɔ kple S3 hiãe.
s3-sse: Ɣaɣla le sɛva ƒe akpa dzi
s3-sse-none: Wometsɔ naneke o (gaze la ƒe gɔmedzedze)
s3-sse-description: S3 ɣlaa nu siwo katã WeKan ŋlɔna: nu si wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu, nɔnɔmetata kple megbenudzraɖoɖo ɖe sia ɖe, eye wòɖea eɖe na WeKan ne woxlẽe.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: KMS safui ƒe ID na SSE-KMS (ƒuƒlu = akɔnt la ƒe gɔmedzedze safui)
azure-connection-string-description: Menye se o: zã kadodo ƒe fli bliboa le akɔnta ƒe ŋkɔ kple key teƒe.
database-migration-description: Sɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nyatakakawo (nu sia nu negbe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu kple nɔnɔmetatawo, siwo susɔa le agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi) le MongoDB kple FerretDB v1 (SQLite) dome. Ele be nyatakakadzraɖoƒe bubu la nanɔ dɔ wɔm eye woate ŋu ayi egbɔ (mɔnu gɔmedzedze: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; trɔ̃ kple WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Ne ewu enu la, ɖo MONGO_URL ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe bubu la ŋu eye nàgbugbɔ dze WeKan gɔme (le Snap dzi: snap set wekan database=ferretdb alo =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Sɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nyatakakawo yi FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Sɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nyatakakawo yi MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nudzraɖoƒewo katã yi __db__? Nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu kple nɔnɔmetatawo le agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi metrɔ̃ o. Ele be yiteƒe ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe nanɔ dɔ wɔm.
sandstorm-migration-description: Ne WeKan le dɔ wɔm le Sandstorm grain me la, woasɔ eƒe MongoDB 3 nyatakakadzraɖoƒe xoxoa yi FerretDB v1 (SQLite) le gɔmedzedze gbãtɔ, eye woatsɔ nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu kple nɔnɔmetatawo tso nyatakakadzraɖoƒe la yi grain ƒe files/attachments kple files/avatars agbalẽdzraɖoƒewo me. Esia fia ne nusɔsɔ ma dze edzi kple disk teƒe nenie MongoDB ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔ xoxowo gale zazãm le grain me, eye ena mɔ be nàtu agbalẽ gɔŋgɔ mawo be nàɖe teƒe ɖe go.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Tutu MongoDB nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔwo
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Nusɔsɔ si dze edzi megbe la, nyatakakawo nɔa FerretDB me kple agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi, eya ta woate ŋu atu MongoDB 3 nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔ xoxowo be woaɖe grain ƒe disk teƒe ɖe go. Womate ŋu agbugbɔ esia o.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Tutu MongoDB 3 nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔwo be nàɖe disk teƒe ɖe go? Wosɔ nyatakakawo yi FerretDB kple agbalẽ ƒe mɔ̃ dzi xoxo. Womate ŋu agbugbɔ esia o.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Wotutu MongoDB nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe agbalẽ gɔŋgɔwo, woɖe teƒe ɖe go
features-desc: Dɔwɔnu siwo WeKan naa be nàtia. Woɣla dɔwɔnu si wometia o tso ezalawo katã gbɔ. Wodzraa eƒe nyatakakawo ɖo eye mɔɖeɖewo metrɔna o.
feature-views-table-desc: Ŋɔŋlɔkpe abe agbalẽviwo ƒe kpekpe si woate ŋu aɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu ene.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalenda kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe geɖe ƒe kalenda.
feature-views-overview-desc: Xexlẽme, hatsotso ɖe ame si wotsɔ dɔ de asi nɛ nu, dɔwɔɖoɖo, nudzɔdzɔwo ƒe ŋɔŋlɔkpe kple ŋɔŋlɔkpe gã.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Gantt nɔnɔmetata kpɔkpɔ ƒe mɔ etɔ̃awo.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Nuwɔwɔ ƒe dɔ siwo susɔ, dɔwɔɣeyiɣi kpuiwo, ɣeyiɣi ma ƒe akɔnta kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe kabakaba.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Dɔ siwo susɔ, dɔ siwo wowu enu, dɔyiyi ƒe ƒuƒoƒo, dɔwɔɣeyiɣi kple lalãɣeyiɣi, dɔ siwo wowu enu ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ, ɣeyiɣi si dɔwo lala, nuxetsinuwo, Monte Carlo kple dɔyiyi ƒe dzidzemɔnu bubuwo.
feature-views-map-desc: Agbalẽviwo abe dzesiwo le nɔnɔmetata si woda ɖo dzi ene.
feature-approval-required: Na dɔwɔnu siwo WeKan yeye tsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu nanɔ tsitsi me va se ɖe esime dzikpɔla aɖoe dɔ me
feature-preview-admins: Dzikpɔlawo kpɔa dɔwɔnu siwo metsi dɔ wɔm o be woado wo kpɔ gbã
feature-pilot-users: Zãla siwo doa wo kpɔ eye wokpɔa dɔwɔnu siwo metsi dɔ wɔm o hã
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Zãlawo ƒe ŋkɔwo, mama wo me kple koma
feature-profiles-desc: Ŋutinya aɖe ɣlaa dɔwɔna siwo dzi wode dzesi la ɖe zãla, ƒuƒoƒo kple habɔbɔ siwo wòle na la. Wogblɔna na zãla ŋutinya si le esi. Ame si si ŋutinya mele o la, naneke mewɔ nɛ o, womeɖea nyatakaka aɖeke ɖa o eye mɔɖeɖe aɖeke metrɔna o.
feature-profile-teams: Ƒuƒoƒowo, ɖeka le fli ɖeka dzi
feature-profile-orgs: Habɔbɔwo, ɖeka le fli ɖeka dzi
feature-profile-notice: Wò dɔwɔnawo ƒe ŋutinya __name__ ɣla dɔwɔna __count__. Bia dɔdzikpɔla aɖe ne èhiã wo dometɔ ɖeka.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Wodzrae ɖo. Womekpɔ zãlawo ƒe ŋkɔ siawo o:
card-field-visibility-desc: Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖoɖowo / Kaɖi ƒe agble siwo kpekpeɖeŋuwo ate ŋu afia. Agble si womede dzesi o la, woɣlaa le kaɖi ɖesiaɖe, kaɖivi ɖesiaɖe kple kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe ƒe Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖoɖowo / Kaɖi me. Kaɖi ƒe nyatakaka alo kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe ɖoɖo aɖeke metrɔna o, eye ne èdee dzesi ake la, kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe dzena abe ale si woɖoe ene. Agblewo ƒe ɖoɖo nye kpekpeɖeŋu ɖesiaɖe ŋutɔ tɔ.
cards-loading-description: WeKan dea kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe kaɖiwo eɖokui: kpekpeɖeŋu gã (si le lolome seƒoƒo dzi) dea kaɖi siwo dzena fifia ko (infinite scroll) kple xexlẽme gbagbe, ale wòle kabã eye wòzãa ŋkuɖoɖo kple nyatakaka ƒe mɔ sue wu, gake kpekpeɖeŋu suewo dea kaɖi ɖesiaɖe na mɔ bɔbɔetɔ kple dɔwɔna bliboa. Naneke meli be woaɖo o. Dɔdzikpɔlawo ate ŋu ana mɔ nanye se kple CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) kple CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD ƒe mɔ̃ ƒe ŋkɔwo.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy kaɖi ƒe numedede nye dodokpɔ: kaɖi ƒe xexlẽlawo kple WIP ƒe seƒoƒowo sɔ, gake Kalenda/Kplɔ̃/Gantt nukpɔkpɔwo kple tiatia geɖe fiaa kaɖi siwo wode va se ɖe fifia ko. Gbugbɔ de kpekpeɖeŋu siwo le ʋuʋu ne ètrɔ̃ esia.
render-links-as-plain-text: Fia kadodowo abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Ne womɔe la, kadodowo katã (markdown kadodowo abe [label](url) kple HTML gɔŋgɔ <a href> tagwo siaa) dzena ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe si womate ŋu azi dzi o ene le nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe me (kpekpeɖeŋu kple kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔwo, numeɖeɖewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo, kple bubuwo). Esia xea mɔ na kadodo siwo ate ŋu ablu ame. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ, eya ta woate ŋu azi kadodowo dzi.
always-show-code-as-text: Fia code katã ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene
always-show-code-as-text-description: Ne womɔe la, womafia nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe abe markdown alo HTML ene gbeɖe o: wofiaa nutoƒe bliboa ɣesiaɣi abe nuŋɔŋlɔ bɔbɔe ene le nuŋɔŋlɔ kɔkɔe ƒe agble ɖesiaɖe me (kpekpeɖeŋu kple kaɖi ƒe ŋkɔwo, numeɖeɖewo, nyaŋuɖoɖowo, ŋkuɖodzinudzesiwo, kple bubuwo). Esia ɖea emenya siwo woɣla — HTML nyaŋuɖoɖowo (<!-- -->), markdown kadodowo ƒe yiteƒe, JavaScript kple code bubu ɖesiaɖe — fia, ale code katã dzena ɣesiaɣi, womate ŋu azi dzi o, eye mele dɔ wɔm o. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ, eya ta wofiaa markdown abe ale si wòle ene.
disable-all-import: Xe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ vavã katã
disable-all-import-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã: kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã tso WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea kple Forgejo, kple kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe evelia wɔwɔ. Woɣla nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe menu tiatiwo eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbea nu tsɔtsɔ vavã ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
import-max-megabytes-description: Faɛl gãtɔ si Tsɔ va eme ƒe axa la xɔna, le megabytes me. Ne eƒo ko la, efia be seɖoƒe aɖeke meli o: faɛl ate ŋu alolo abe ale si teƒe ƒuƒlu si le disk dzi ana nu tsɔtsɔ va eme nawu enu ene. Woŋlɔa nu sia nu si wotsɔ ɖe dzi ɖe server ƒe disk dzi akpa ɖeka ɖeka, eye wogbea nu tsɔtsɔ va eme si ayɔ disk la fũ.
import-disk-full: Teƒe ƒuƒlu si sɔ gbɔ mele server ƒe disk dzi na nu tsɔtsɔ va eme sia o.
import-upload-not-found: Faɛl si wotsɔ ɖe dzi la megale afi ma o. Gatiae.
import-upload-failed: Womete ŋu tsɔ faɛl la ɖe dzi o.
import-upload-aborted: Wotso nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe dzi la dome.
disable-all-export: Xe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go katã
disable-all-export-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe dɔwɔnawo katã: kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go abe WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, alo yi NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, kple nusi wokpe ɖe eŋu ɖeka ƒe nuɖeɖego. Woɣla nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe menu tiatiwo eye dɔdzikpɔla la gbea nu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go ƒe biabia ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-import-avatars: Xe mɔ na nɔnɔmetata tsɔtsɔ vavã
disable-import-avatars-description: Ne womɔe la, womatsɔ nɔnɔmetatawo (zazãla ƒe ŋutinya nɔnɔmetatawo) ava eme gbeɖe o. Esia kpɔa WeKan JSON nu tsɔtsɔ vavã, Trello nu tsɔtsɔ vavã, kple nɔnɔmetata ɖoɖo ɖe gotagome dzenawo ŋutinya kpɔkpɔlawo ŋu le gegeɖeme (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2) gbɔ. Wogatsɔ ŋkɔwo kple nyatakaka bubuwo ava eme; nɔnɔmetatawo ko woadzo le ŋu. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-export-avatars: Xe mɔ na nɔnɔmetata tsɔtsɔ ɖe go
disable-export-avatars-description: Ne womɔe la, womatsɔ nɔnɔmetatawo (zazãla ƒe ŋutinya nɔnɔmetatawo) ade kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go (WeKan JSON kple CSV nuɖeɖego) me gbeɖe o. Woagatsɔ zazãlaŋkɔwo kple nyatakaka bubuwo aɖe go; nɔnɔmetatawo ko woagblẽ ɖi. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-import-users: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ va eme ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-import-users-description: Ne womɔe la, WeKan JSON kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ vavã trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ va eme ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo siwo wotsɔ va eme me. Womadzra zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo tso nutoƒe kpekpeɖeŋu la ɖo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm vavã la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-export-users: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-export-users-description: Ne womɔe la, kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ƒe emenyawo me. Agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe go makɔ zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm ɖe go la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
anonymize-account: Ɣla zazãla siwo wotsɔ va eme ƒe dzenawo
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ne womɔe la, kpekpeɖeŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe go trɔ̃a zazãla ɖesiaɖe si wotsɔ ɖe go ƒe zazãlaŋkɔ, ŋkɔ bliboa kple ŋkɔwo ƒe dzesi gbãtɔwo wozua xexlẽla ƒe teƒenɔlawo (user1, user2, ...), gblẽa eƒe nɔnɔmetata ɖi, eye wòŋlɔa @username yɔyɔwo (kple ame-si-bia / ame-si-de-dɔ agblewo) yeye le kaɖi kple nyaŋuɖoɖo ƒe emenyawo me. Agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe go makɔ zazãla ŋutɔ ƒe dzenawo o. Nya "user" dzea ame si le nu tsɔm ɖe go la ƒe gbe yome. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-activities-description: Ne womɔe la, womede dɔwɔwɔ ƒe nyadzraɖoƒe ƒe emenyawo gbeɖe o, eye womafia wo le teƒe aɖeke o (kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe gbɔgbɔmenu kple kaɖi ƒe dɔwɔwɔ tab). Womadzra ame si wɔ nu kple nusi wòwɔ ƒe ŋutinya aɖeke ɖo o. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-notifications: Xe mɔ na nyanyanana wo katã
disable-notifications-description: Ne womɔe la, WeKan maɖo ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe nyanyanana (le app me, email alo subɔsubɔ bubuwo) gbeɖe na dɔwɔwɔ ɖesiaɖe o. Woate ŋu agade dɔwɔwɔwo (ne womexe mɔ na wo le tame o); nyanyanana wo ko wotu ɖi. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
disable-watch-description: Ne womɔe la, woxe mɔ na ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe dɔwɔna — zazãlawo mate ŋu aŋlɔ ŋkɔ ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu, xexlẽdzesi alo kaɖiwo ŋu be woaxɔ nyanyanana o, eye woagbe ŋudzɔdzɔ ƒe afɔɖeɖe tɔtrɔ ƒe kpɔkpɔ ɖesiaɖe. Gɔmedzedze nye mɔxexlẽ.
backup-description: Dzra Nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu, Nɔnɔmetatawo kple/alo Nyatakakawo (nuŋɔŋlɔ-nɔnɔme ƒe nudzraɖoƒewo katã siwo menye nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu alo nɔnɔmetatawo o) ɖo ɖe megbe. Wotsɔa .zip la yia nudzraɖoƒe si wotia la gbɔ enumake — ɣeyiɣi kpui ƒe agbalẽ aɖeke meli o — abe backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip ene, si me YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars kple /data le. Alilikpo nudzraɖoƒewo (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) zãa dzenawo si woɖo le woƒe nudzraɖoƒe tabwo me.
backup-scope-description: Mɔ̃ bliboa, alo Habɔbɔ ɖeka. Habɔbɔ ƒe megbenudzraɖoɖo kɔa eƒe kpekpeɖeŋuwo kple nusiwo katã le wo dzi, si me kpekpeɖeŋu mawo ƒe nusiwo wokpe ɖe eŋu le — gake zazãla ƒe akɔntawo kple mɔ̃ ƒe ɖoɖowo mele eme o, elabena habɔbɔ ɖesiaɖe ma wo. Habɔbɔ ƒe megbenudzraɖoɖo gbugbɔɖoɖo ŋlɔa ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu siwo Habɔbɔ ma nye tɔ ko dzi.

Ewɔa dɔ kple megbenudzraɖoɖo si woɖo ɣeyiɣi na, si dzraa nuwo katã ɖo.

Le "New principals" me, tsɔ subɔsubɔ akɔnta email la de afisia — "client_email" asixɔxɔ tso wò JSON key me — emegbe tia dɔdeasi "Storage Object Admin" eye nàdzra ɖo.

s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → wò zazãla → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → tia zazã ƒe nɔnɔme 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Wofiaa abe 'Access key ID' ene.

gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wò bucket ƒe ŋkɔ (alo Create be nàwɔ ɖeka).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Mɔ le WeKan dɔdzikpɔla dzi yi subɔsubɔ akɔnta JSON key agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe anyi (si wowɔ le ete). Zã esia ALO tsɔ JSON de agble si le ete me.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → wò subɔsubɔ akɔnta → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (etsɔa agbalẽ la ɖe anyi). Tsɔ eƒe emenyawo de afisia, alo dzra agbalẽ la ɖo eye nàɖo eƒe mɔ le tame.

Vodada siwo anɔ anyi tegbee kple gbedeasi siwo va ɖo agbagbadzedze ƒe seɖoƒe la anɔ anyi na numetoto. Agbagbadzedze ake le gbedeasi siwo medze edzi o ŋu dzea agbagbadzedze yeye gɔme eye wòléa tete vie si li xoxo la ɖe asi.

optional-apis-desc: REST API siwo le abe nyawo kpɔkplɔ dɔwɔnu bubuwo ƒe API ene, ale be woƒe dɔwɔnuwo kple scriptwo nate ŋu azã WeKan sia abe woƒe megbe-dɔwɔƒe ene: nu siwo wodzra ɖo la nɔa WeKan me, le WeKan ŋɔŋlɔkpewo dzi. Wotsi wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe va se ɖe esime wodze dzesi ɖe edzi le afii. Ɖeke mekpɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe mɔɖeɖewo o: client ge ɖe eme kple WeKan API token eye ate ŋu akpɔ ahatrɔ nu siwo ame ma ate ŋu akpɔ ahatrɔ le WeKan me ɖeɖeko. Wo katã hiã be WeKan REST API nanɔ dɔwɔwɔ me (WITH_API=true). Adrɛs si le ɖe sia ɖe te enye esi client zãna abe eƒe server ene.
optional-api-trello-desc: Dɔwɔnu kple script siwo woŋlɔ na Trello ƒe REST API (le kpɔɖeŋu me Trellinator) wɔa dɔ kple WeKan: ŋɔŋlɔkpewo, xexlẽdzesiwo, agbalẽviwo, dzesiwo, hametɔwo, nuŋɔŋlɔwo kple dodokpɔ xexlẽdzesiwo. Trello token nye WeKan API token. Ne èɖe agbalẽvi ɖa la, eyina dzraɖoƒe le WeKan me.
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira ƒe REST API v2 ƒe clientwo wɔa dɔ kple WeKan: dɔɖoɖo nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe (eƒe safui nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe safui), nya nye agbalẽvi (DEV-7), nɔnɔme nye xexlẽdzesi, eye tɔtrɔ ʋãa agbalẽvia. Didi xɔa JQL bɔbɔe: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text kple ORDER BY. Ge ɖe eme kple WeKan API token abe mɔxenya ene. Ne èɖe nya ɖa la, eyina dzraɖoƒe.
optional-api-github-desc: GitHub ƒe REST API na nyawo ƒe clientwo wɔa dɔ kple WeKan: nudzraɖoƒe nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe, nya nye agbalẽvi, kple dzesiwo, ŋkeke vevewo (dzesi siwo si nuwuwu ŋkeke le), nuŋɔŋlɔwo, kple ʋuʋu alo tutu abe le Ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe nukpɔkpɔ / Tɔtrɔ ƒe dzikpɔkpɔ me ene. Token la nye WeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Gitea kple Forgejo ƒe REST API na nyawo ƒe clientwo wɔa dɔ kple WeKan le mɔ ɖeka ma nu abe API si sɔ kple GitHub ene: nudzraɖoƒe nye ŋɔŋlɔkpe eye nya nye agbalẽvi. Token la nye WeKan API token.

Ŋlɔ host siwo le network ma dzi siwo webhookwo ate ŋu aɖo la ɖe afi sia - Node-RED, nuƒoƒo ƒe server - ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe dzi, abe ŋkɔ alo adrɛs ene, kple port be woaɖe mɔ na port ma ɖeɖe ko. Naneke mele eme o: ɖeke o. Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ƒe dɔdzikpɔlawo ɖeɖe koe ate ŋu atrɔ nuŋlɔɖi sia.

cloud-panel-import-files: Nu __count__ siwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu: kɔpi faɛlwo hã tso WeKan xoxo ƒe faɛldzraɖoƒe.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin le anyi ɖe address si server la ƒe CLOUD ɖoɖo ƒe tɔtrɔ ŋlɔ la ko dzi, na eƒe Cloud Admin-wo kple na domain siwo wòŋlɔ la ƒe asisiwo.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: IPv4 kple IPv6 address-wo, kple address ƒe nɔnɔme abe 203.0.113.0/24 ene, siwo dzi Cloud Admin ate ŋu age ɖe eme tso. Ɖeka le sɛrɛ ɖe sia ɖe me. Ƒuƒlu: address ɖe sia ɖe.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Wò address __address__ mele ŋkɔdzesi sia me o. Ne wodzra ɖo la, ana nàɖe go, eyata womedzra ɖo o.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: IPv4 kple IPv6 address siwo kple address ƒe kekeme siwo, ɖeka le fli ɖesiaɖe dzi, siwo dzi woate ŋu azã Dɔdzikpɔla ƒe teƒe kple admin REST API. Naneke mele eme o: address ɖesiaɖe.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Server ƒe environment variable ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES ye tsoa nya me, menye list sia o.
admin-panel-address-refused: Womate ŋu azã Dɔdzikpɔla ƒe teƒe tso wò address __address__ dzi o.
website-view-empty: Wometa naneke ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe sia dzi haɖe o.
feature-views-website-desc: Kpo la abe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe ene: eƒe Published xexlẽdzesi ƒe kaɖwo, mɔ Pages abe menu ene kple kaɖ bubuawo abe nyatakakawo ene, yeyeawo gbã, kple woƒe nusiwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu. Kpo si le dutoƒo ate ŋu aʋu le eme, ale be amedzrowo akpɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒe la le kpo la ƒe adrɛs dzi.
feature-views-shop-desc: Nu siwo le kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe agbalẽviwo dzi abe internet dzi nudzraƒe ene: agbalẽvi si asi le dzi nye nu si wodzrana, eƒe dzesiwo nye hatsotsoawo, eye nubiabia nye agbalẽvi si le Nubiabiawo ƒe xexlẽdzesi me. Kpekpeɖeŋu si le ame sia ame ŋu ate ŋu aʋu le eme, ale be amedzrowo aƒle nu le kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe adrɛs dzi.
shop-sku-field: Nu ƒe dzesixexlẽ (wò ŋutɔ wò teƒe)
shop-stock-field: Nu siwo li (wò ŋutɔ wò teƒe)
shop-decrement-stock: Ɖe nu siwo wobia la ɖa le nu siwo li me
shop-sale-lists: Xexlẽdzesi siwo dzi wodzra nu le (naneke medzesi o: xexlẽdzesiwo katã negbe Nubiabiawo ƒe xexlẽdzesi)
shop-category-labels: Dzesi siwo woɖe fia abe hatsotsowo ene (naneke medzesi o: dzesiwo katã)
shop-orders-private: Woŋlɔa nubiabiawo ɖe kpekpeɖeŋu si nye ame ŋutɔ tɔ dzi, elabena kpekpeɖeŋu si le ame sia ame ŋu ɖea agbalẽvi ɖesiaɖe fiaa ame sia ame.
shop-guest-checkout: Amedzro siwo si akɔnta mele o ate ŋu abia nu
shop-show-on-public: Ɖe Nudzraƒe la fia le kpekpeɖeŋu si le ame sia ame ŋu teƒe
shop-show-on-public-note: Kpekpeɖeŋu si le ame sia ame ŋu ʋuna le nukpɔkpɔ ɖeka ko me. Ne èti Nudzraƒe le afisia la, axɔ __view__ ƒe teƒe na amedzrowo, eye ne èti Nyatakakadzraɖoƒe alo nukpɔkpɔ bubu le Ŋɔŋlɔkpe ƒe ɖoɖowo / Kpekpeɖeŋu ƒe nukpɔkpɔ me la, axɔ Nudzraƒe la ƒe teƒe.
shop-empty: Nu aɖeke meli haɖe o. Agbalẽvi si asi le dzi le xexlẽdzesi si dzi wodzra nu le me la nye nu si wodzrana.
shop-login-to-order: Ge ɖe eme be nàbia nu.
shop-privacy-note: Woŋlɔa wò ŋkɔ kple wò kadodonyatakakawo ɖe nubiabia la dzi be nudzraƒe la natsɔe vɛ na wò, eye womeŋlɔnɛ ɖe teƒe bubu o.
shop-price-changed: Asi aɖe trɔ. Kpɔ ƒoƒui yeye la eye nàgabia nua.
shop-confirmation-email: Ɖo nubiabia ŋuti kpeɖodzinya ɖe nuƒlela le e-mail dzi
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Le WordPress me la, tia Tools, Export, All content kple Download Export File, eye nàtia .xml faɛl ma le afisia, alo nàtsɔ eƒe nuŋlɔɖi ade eme. Squarespace, Wix kple nyatakakadzraɖoƒe bubu siwo ɖoa WordPress faɛl ɖa la wɔa dɔ nenema ke. Axa kple nyatakaka ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ le eƒe nɔnɔme ƒe xexlẽdzesi me, axawo le mɔ Pages me eye nyatakakawo le Posts me, kple eƒe emenyawo, eƒe hatsotsowo kple tagwo abe dzesiwo ene, kple eƒe nyagbɔgblɔ siwo wolɔ̃ ɖe edzi.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Dzra WordPress REST API ƒe nyatakakawo kple axawo (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts kple /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) ɖo abe .json faɛl ɖeka ene, eye nàtiae le afisia alo nàtsɔe ade eme. Axa kple nyatakaka ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ le eƒe nɔnɔme ƒe xexlẽdzesi me.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Le Ghost me la, tia Settings, Labs, Export your content, eye nàtia .json faɛl la le afisia alo nàtsɔe ade eme. Axa kple nyatakaka ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ le eƒe nɔnɔme ƒe xexlẽdzesi me, kple eƒe tagwo abe dzesiwo ene.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Le Blogger me la, tia Settings, Back up content, eye nàtia .xml faɛl la le afisia alo nàtsɔ eƒe nuŋlɔɖi ade eme. Nyatakaka kple axa ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ, nusi womewu nu o le xexlẽdzesi Draft me, kple eƒe dzesiwo kple nyagbɔgblɔwo.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Tsɔ Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro alo nyatakakadzraɖoƒe bubu si metrɔna o ƒe dzɔtsoƒewo de .zip me - Markdown faɛlwo kple woƒe front matter, kple woƒe nɔnɔmetatawo - eye nàtia .zip la le afisia. Markdown faɛl ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ: nyatakaka siwo tso posts faɛldzraɖoƒewo alo ŋkekenyanu le faɛl ƒe ŋkɔ me, susɔeawo nye axawo, nusiwo womewu nu o le xexlẽdzesi Draft me, kple nɔnɔmetata siwo wòzãna abe eƒe nusiwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu ene.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Tsɔ nyatakakadzraɖoƒe aɖe ƒe faɛlwo de .zip me - eƒe .html axawo kple nɔnɔmetatawo, abe ale si wodzra wo ɖo kple wget alo HTTrack ene, alo Medium ƒe ɖoɖoɖa - eye nàtia .zip la le afisia. Axa ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ kple eƒe nuŋlɔɖi vevitɔ, kple nɔnɔmetata siwo wòzãna abe eƒe nusiwo wotsɔ kpe ɖe eŋu ene; woɖe scripts, menuwo kple formwo ɖa.
import-board-instruction-substack: Le Substack me la, tia Settings, Exports, Create new export, eye nàtia .zip si nèɖe la le afisia. Nyatakaka ɖesiaɖe zua kaɖ kple eƒe nuŋlɔɖi, wota alo womewu nu o.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Swimlanes divide the board into horizontal bands, so each card belongs to both a list and a swimlane. A lane can stand for a team, a person, a customer or a kind of work, while the lists keep showing the stages of the work.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Click + in a swimlane header, or choose Add Swimlane in its menu, type a name and choose whether it goes above or below the selected lane. Pasting several lines can create one swimlane per line. Click a name to rename it, use the caret to collapse or expand a lane, drag its handle to reorder lanes, and drag its bottom edge to change its height unless a board admin has locked resizing.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Lists are the columns that hold the cards. On a kanban board each list is a stage of the work, and a card moves from list to list as the work goes on. In Swimlanes view a list can belong to one swimlane.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Click the add list icon at the right end of a list header, or Add in the list menu, type a name and choose which list it comes after; pasting several lines can create one list per line. Click a list title to rename it, and the caret in its header collapses or expands it just for you. The list menu also has copy, move and archive, and you can drag the handle between lists to resize them when resizing is allowed.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: The Table view shows the board's cards as a spreadsheet-like table, one row per card, with its list, swimlane, people, labels and dates. It is handy for scanning many cards at once and for adding or moving cards without dragging them across lists.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Click a column header to sort, and click it again to reverse the order. Type in the search box to match card titles, lists, swimlanes and labels, and use Previous and Next to page through 25 rows at a time. The Edit button opens a card over the table. Wrap titles and Group by swimlane change the layout and are remembered in this browser. Archived cards are left out, and the sidebar Filter narrows the rows.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: The Calendar view places the board's cards on a calendar by their dates: a card with start and end dates as a bar between them, and its received, due and end dates as their own entries. Dated checklist items appear too.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Use Today, Previous and Next to move around, and switch between day, week and month, each as a grid or a list. Drag a card to give it a new due date, or stretch it to change its end date. Click a day, or drag over hours in the week or day grid, to create a new card due then; it goes to the board's first swimlane and first list.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Calendar Mode shows each card on the day of its due date, with its labels and full title, in a month or week grid. It is a read-only overview of what is due when, similar to the Trello calendar.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Use Today, Previous and Next to move by a month or a week, and Week or Month to switch the grid; the choice is remembered in this browser. Click a card to open it. Archived cards are left out and the sidebar Filter applies. To change dates by dragging, use the Calendar view instead.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Multi Board Calendar shows the dated cards of every board you are a member of in one calendar, so you can see everything due this week no matter which board it is on. Each entry starts with its board's title in brackets.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Open it from the Board View menu of any board and wait until the cards of all your boards have loaded. Use Today, Previous and Next and the day, week and month views, each also as a list. Received, due and end dates get their own entries. Click an entry to open that card on its board. Dates cannot be dragged here.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: The Time view gathers the board's time tracking in one place: how much time has been spent, by whom and on which cards, and how much time is left until cards are due. Time is entered on the cards themselves; this view only reports it.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Read the time spent summary at the top, then the breakdown by assignee and by card, with overtime cards marked. Below it every change to a card's recorded hours is listed by the person who made it. Click Export to save the report as PDF or Excel. Members who may only see cards assigned to them get the summary for their own cards, while the other sections stay empty.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: The Timeline view shows the board as it was at an earlier moment, using the board's history. It helps you see what changed and put a card back the way it was.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Click a point on the line to see each card as it was then, grouped by its list at that time, with its title, description, labels, members and due date. Click Now to return to the present. On a card, Restore to this state sets those values back after you confirm. Nothing is deleted: the restore is recorded as new history, and the button is shown only to people who may change that card.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Statistics shows the board's status at a glance: how its cards are loaded and how many swimlanes, lists, cards, archived cards, labels, members and custom fields it has.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Open Statistics from the Overview group of the Board View menu and read the Board status table. Card loading tells whether this board loads only the visible cards or all cards, and whether that was chosen automatically for a big board. The counts are computed on the server, so they are right even on a large board. Any value can be selected and copied, and opening the view changes nothing.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Group by Assignee lists every card under the person it is assigned to, instead of under its list, so you can see who has what without opening each list. It suits a team meeting.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Open it from the Board View menu. Each assignee gets a section with their cards, the due date where one is set and a clock when a card is over time; cards without an assignee are under No assignee. Click a card title to open the card. The grouping uses the card's Assignee field, not its Members. People whose role only lets them see cards assigned to them get no data here.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: The Gantt views draw the board's cards on a calendar so you can see what starts, what is due and what overlaps. Gantt is a table with one row per card and an icon for each of its dates, while Frappe Gantt and DHTMLX Gantt draw each card as a bar from start to end.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Choose Gantt, Frappe Gantt or DHTMLX Gantt in the Calendar and time group of the Board View menu; cards need at least one received, start, due or end date. In Gantt, each week with dates gets its own table; click a card name to open the card or a date icon to edit that date. In Frappe Gantt and DHTMLX Gantt, members with write access can drag a bar to reschedule the card.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: The Product Backlog is the ordered list of work a Scrum team has not yet taken into a sprint. It shows the board's cards that have no current sprint, ordered by backlog rank, without moving them out of their lists.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Find a card in the table and, in its Actions cell, set its Sprint, Backlog rank, Release, Work item type and Acceptance criteria, then click Save. Smaller ranks come first. Hold Ctrl, or Cmd on a Mac, to put a card in several releases. Click a card title to open the card, and Show more to load the next 100 cards. Editing follows the usual card permissions.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: A sprint is a short, fixed period in which a Scrum team finishes a chosen set of work toward a goal. The Sprints view is where the board's sprints are planned, started, closed or cancelled, along with its releases and Scrum events.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: A board admin first opens Scrum settings, turns on Scrum planning and chooses the estimate source, unit, completion policy and working days. Then create a planned sprint with a name, goal, start and end, assign cards to it from the Product Backlog, and click Start sprint. To finish, choose where unfinished work goes and click Close sprint, or give a reason and click Cancel sprint. Only board admins manage sprints.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: A sprint report tells what happened in one closed sprint: what was committed, completed, added, removed and left unfinished. Velocity lists those results for every closed sprint, so the next sprint can be planned from what the team really did.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: In Sprint Report, choose a sprint and choose Cards or Estimate above the bars, then read the daily scope and remaining work and the change-by-change history below. In Velocity, read one row per closed sprint. Results come from snapshots taken when each sprint started and closed, so later estimate changes do not rewrite them. Export saves the results as PDF or Excel, and Refresh reloads the report.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: These Scrum charts show progress over time. Burndown shows how much work is left day by day and Burnup how much is done, Velocity shows how much each closed sprint completed, Release Burndown follows the work left in a release, and Epic Progress shows how far parent cards have come.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Choose the chart under Scrum in the Board View menu. Each draws from the board's own cards and sprints and shows the numbers in a table under the chart. Velocity needs at least one closed sprint, and lets you choose Cards or Estimate. Click Export at the top to save the same numbers as PDF or Excel. A chart with nothing to draw yet says No results.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: The Roadmap groups cards into rows by the value of a custom field, such as a release or an epic, and draws each row's cards on a timeline. It is useful for a release or theme roadmap when that grouping is already kept in a custom field.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: The board needs at least one text or dropdown custom field. Choose the field in Group by at the top; each value gets its own small Gantt chart of its cards, and cards without a value are grouped under No value. Cards are placed by their dates, so give them start and due dates to see them on the timeline.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: These Overview charts answer how busy the board is and how its work is spread: Dashboard and Pulse summarize the board, Workload shows who has what, Distribution how cards are divided, Dependency Map how cards block or depend on each other, and Activity Heatmap when people work on the board.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Choose a chart in the Overview group of the Board View menu. Each page draws the chart from the board's cards and history and shows the table of numbers behind it. Click Export at the top to save the same data as PDF or Excel. When there is nothing to draw yet, the chart says No results.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard stacks every board you are a member of on one scrollable page, each with its own lists and cards, so you can work on all your boards at once.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Open Bigboard from the Board View menu and wait while every board's cards load. Each board section works like a normal board: drag cards between lists, open cards and edit lists. You can also drag a card into a list of another board on the page, which moves it to that board. Lists can only be dragged within their own board. Click a board's title to open it on its own.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: The Kanban flow charts show how work moves through the board: cumulative flow, control and cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, throughput, WIP, aging work, blockers, forecasts of when work will be done, process behavior and whether bigger estimates take longer. They help you find where work piles up and how long it really takes.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Choose a chart in the Kanban flow group of the Board View menu. Read the note under the title, which says how it measures, then the chart and the table under it. Some pages take settings, such as target cards and date for Monte Carlo Forecasts or the size field for Work Item Size vs. Cycle Time, applied with Apply. Export at the top saves the tables as PDF or Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: These reports show how work flows through the board week by week: cards created and finished, net flow, how long cards stay in each list, the average age of open cards, the weekly throughput and how often due dates are met.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Choose a report in the Kanban flow group of the Board View menu: Created vs. Resolved, Net Flow, Time in List, Average Age, Throughput Run Chart or Due Date Performance. Each shows a chart and, under it, the table of numbers it is drawn from. Click Export at the top to save that table as PDF or Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: The Map view shows the board's cards as markers on an image the board admin uploads, such as a floor plan or site map. It suits work that happens in places, like rooms, machines or plots.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: A board admin clicks Upload a map image and chooses a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file, and can remove it later without losing the card places. People who may change the board see the cards that are not on the map yet; drag one onto the image, or choose it and click where it belongs, and drag a marker to move it. A marker takes the colour of the card's first label, and clicking it opens the card.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: The Email view shows the board as a mailbox: cards are the messages, lists are the folders and labels are the labels. You can write and answer email from the board's own address, so replies come back to the board as cards and comments.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Click Inbox, Sent, All mail, a list or a label to choose what is shown, type in the search box to narrow the rows, and click a row to open the card, whose comments are the conversation. Compose writes a new email and the reply arrow answers one, sent from the board's address. The board must first receive email, turned on in the board's Notification Settings under Email to card.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: The Chat view shows the board as a chat workspace: each card with a conversation is a channel and its comments are the messages. The channel tree covers every board you can see, with the number of messages you have not read.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Open a workspace and a board in Channels and click a card; it opens in the middle pane and its messages in the chat pane. Type a message and press Enter or click Send; Shift+Enter starts a new line. To start a conversation on a card with no messages, click Show all cards for that board and pick the card. The panes are mirrored for right-to-left languages.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: The Version Control view shows the board as a code repository's issue tracker: cards are issues, labels are labels, labels with a due date are milestones, comments are the conversation and attachments are the files. It also imports and syncs issues from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Browse open and closed issues, filter by label or milestone, and open an issue to read and add to its conversation. A card counts as closed when it is archived or in a list such as Closed or Done. New issues become cards in the board's open list, and Close or Reopen moves the card between the open and closed lists. Everything is ordinary card data, so changes are kept in the board's history.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Column sets let you arrange the same cards in extra ways, such as by priority, milestone or size, without moving any card out of its list. Each set has its own coloured columns.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: A board admin types a name in New column set and clicks Add, then adds columns with a name and colour. Choose a set at the top; every card is in one of its columns or in Not placed. Drag a card to another column to change its place in this set only; its list, swimlane, labels and members stay the same. Each card also shows small labels for its column in the other sets.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: The Website view shows the board as a website built from its own cards and attachments, for example a site imported from WordPress, Ghost, Blogger or a static site. A public board can open in this view, so visitors see the site at the board's address.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Cards in a list named Published are on the site, or every list's cards when there is no such list; archived cards never show. Cards in a swimlane named Pages form the menu, with subtasks as sub-pages, and the other cards are posts on the front page, newest first. A card's description is the page text and its attachments are its images and files. To use it as a public board's view, choose it in Board Settings / Board View.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: The Shop view shows the products on the board's cards as a web shop, with pictures, prices, categories, a product page, a cart and a checkout. A card in a list on sale becomes a product when its price field has a number, and its labels become categories.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: A board admin sets the shop up in Board Settings / Shop: the price, product code and stock fields, a private Orders list, the currency, VAT, payment methods, the lists on sale and the labels shown as categories, then ticks The shop is open. Shoppers filter by category, add products to the cart and check out. Each order becomes a new card in the Orders list, and the buyer gets a confirmation email.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: The Filter shows only the cards that match what you choose, such as labels, members, assignees, dates, custom field values, card text or how long cards have been in a list. It changes no card and nobody's access, and a combination of filters can be saved under a name and used again.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Choose labels, people, dates or other conditions in the sidebar, and the board shows only the matching cards. Under Labels, OR matches any selected label and AND requires all of them; clicking a selected label again excludes it. Card text applies as you type. Closing the panel keeps the filter on until you clear it. Global Search, also here, finds cards across all your boards.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Search finds the cards and lists of this board whose text contains what you type, and shows each card found on the board itself. On All Boards the same button narrows your list of boards by title.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Type in the field and press Enter. The sidebar lists matching lists and cards, and the first card opens on the board with a counter under the field. Press Enter again for the next card or Shift+Enter for the previous one; the arrows do the same and wrap around. Click a card or list in the results to show it on the board, and click Search again to close the sidebar.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Multi-Selection lets you tick several cards and then do one thing to all of them at once: set a label or member, change the colour, move, copy or archive them. On All Boards it selects boards instead.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Turn on Multi-Selection in the board header, then tick the cards' checkboxes, or use Filter to selection in the Filter sidebar to select every card the filter shows. Choose an action in the sidebar, such as Set label for selection, Move selection or Move selection to Archive. Click Turn Multi-Selection off, the X beside the header button, when you are done. You need permission to change the board.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Custom fields are the board's own extra fields for cards, such as a version, a budget, a customer, a checkbox or a choice from a list. A field is defined once for the board, and each card can hold its own value for it.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Click + to create a field, give it a name and a type (text, number, date, dropdown, multi-select dropdown, checkbox, currency or string template) and choose where it is shown: on the card, on the minicard, on new cards or on every card. The type cannot be changed later. Number and currency fields can show their sum at the top of each list. Card values are then filled in on the opened card.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: The Archive holds the cards, lists and swimlanes that were moved to the Archive. Archiving hides something without losing it, so it can be restored later, while deleting removes it for good.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Choose the Cards, Lists or Swimlanes tab and click Restore beside an item, or Restore all. A card may not be restorable while its list is archived or full under its WIP limit, and the Archive says so. Board admins also see Delete and Delete all, which cannot be undone. Archived boards are restored from the Archive page of All Boards instead.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Original positions shows where each swimlane, list and card was put when it was made, and which of them have moved since. It is useful after a big rearrangement, or to see the title a card was created with.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Read the three groups, Swimlanes, Lists and Cards. Each item shows its current name, Moved when it is no longer where it was put, the place it was created in, its original title when that has changed, and when it was made. Click Refresh to read the board's history again. Items made before positions were recorded have no row.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Summary is a standup report of what happened on the board, person by person, taken from the board's own records. It answers what each of us did in the last day or week, and what is overdue.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Choose Last day or Last week. Each member who did something or has overdue cards gets groups for cards Done, Moved, Added and Commented, plus their Overdue cards, and each card opens from its link. Click Copy as text to copy the whole summary, ready to paste into a chat or an email.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Since your last visit lists what other people changed on this board since you last had it open: new cards, moves, comments, due date changes and members added. The menu entry shows the number of changes.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Opening the board records your visit. Open this view to see the changes grouped by card, newest first, and click a row to open that card. Your own changes are not listed. An administrator can hide the feature in Admin Panel / Settings / Features.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Visibility decides who can see the board: only the people added to it (Private), every signed-in user of this WeKan (Signed-in users), or anybody with the link (Public). Editing stays with the board's members unless a board admin allows otherwise.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: A board admin clicks the visibility button in the board header and chooses Private, Signed-in users or Public; the current choice has a check mark and the button then shows the new setting. On a Signed-in users or Public board, when the administrator allows it, the admin can also tick Everyone signed in can edit. For other people the button only shows the setting.
